_readme: Character, talent-build and matchup model for minmax.py. Values marked PLACEHOLDER should be replaced with numbers from your own level 30 hunter. See README.md 'Calibrating'.

character._base_hp: PLACEHOLDER - naked HP (no talents that change HP) minus 10 x naked stamina
character._base_mana: PLACEHOLDER - naked mana minus 15 x naked intellect
character._base_rap: PLACEHOLDER - naked ranged AP minus naked agility (and minus Careful Aim's int bonus)

ratings._agi_per_crit_pct: PLACEHOLDER - measure it: note crit %, equip/remove a known +Agi item, divide the agi change by the crit change
ratings._agi_per_dodge_pct: PLACEHOLDER - measure it the same way using dodge %

rotation._weapon_dps: Used only when the chosen ranged weapon has no dps value
rotation._shot_dps: PLACEHOLDER - extra DPS from mana shots (Arcane, Serpent, Aimed, Multi) on top of Auto Shot while you have mana
rotation._shot_mana_per_sec: PLACEHOLDER - mana/sec those shots cost before Efficiency. Total mana spent on shots divided by duel time
rotation._pet_dps: PLACEHOLDER - your pet's DPS vs a player, untalented. Doesn't scale with your gear
rotation._fsr_out_frac: Share of the duel spent outside the 5-second rule. Spirit regen only works then

builds._readme: Talent effects come from Wowhead's Forever hunter talent list. 21 points at level 30. Survivalist (SV tier 2) = +10% total Health. Careful Aim (MM tier 2) = AP +100% of Int. Lethal Attacks (MM tier 1) = +5% crit. Efficiency (MM tier 2) = -15% shot/sting mana at 5/5. Mortal Shots (MM tier 4) = +30% ranged crit damage bonus. Lone Wolf (MM tier 3) = +20% damage with no pet. Improved Tracking (SV tier 1) = +5% damage to the tracked type (Humanoids). Focused Fire (BM tier 2) = +4% you and pet. Unleashed Fury (BM tier 3) = +15% pet. Ferocity (BM tier 4) = +10% pet crit.

mm_lone_wolf.desc: 0/21/0: Lethal Attacks 5, Careful Aim 5, Efficiency 4, Lone Wolf 1, Mortal Shots 5, Trueshot Aura 1 - no pet

mm_pet.desc: 0/21/0 with a pet: Lethal Attacks 5, Careful Aim 5, Efficiency 5, Mortal Shots 5, Trueshot Aura 1

sv_mm_tank.desc: 0/11/10: Improved Tracking 5, Survivalist 5 / Lethal Attacks 5, Careful Aim 5, Efficiency 1 - +10% HP, keeps Careful Aim

bm.desc: 21/0/0: Deadly Aspects/Endurance Training, Focused Fire 2, Unleashed Fury 5, Ferocity 5, Summon Hawk, Spirit Bond, Intimidation - no Careful Aim
bm._pet_dps_mult: Focused Fire 4% x Unleashed Fury 15% x ~10% crit from Ferocity, plus the hawk; rough

matchups._readme: duel_sec = how long that duel usually lasts. physical_frac = share of their damage that armor/dodge can reduce. PLACEHOLDERS - adjust after watching duels.

filters._allow_mail: Hunters learn Mail at 40 (Forever's change list doesn't alter that), so mail is off by default. Note some 'Chain' items are leather in Forever (e.g. Highlander's/Defiler's Chain Girdle)
filters._faction: alliance, horde or any - PvP/rep gear like Defiler's (Horde) and Highlander's (Alliance) is faction-locked
filters._allow_no_req_high_ilvl: Items with no level requirement but item level 31-50 (often BoP drops from higher dungeons, e.g. Profane Ritual Robes +17 Agi). Off by default because you may not be able to get them at 30; turn on if you can get carried
filters._allow_duplicate_items: Two copies of the same ring/trinket/weapon. Off by default: many are quest rewards or Unique, and Wowhead's data doesn't always flag Unique
filters._exclude_notes: Drop items whose notes contain any of these strings, e.g. ["Engineering", "reputation item"] if you won't take Engineering or grind rep

_weights_override: Optional: {"sta":1,"agi":0.6,...} to skip the model and use plain stat weights instead
